notes: Source: Hall's Rental Service, Niles IL, 2026 price guide effective April 1, 2026 (prices may change without notice). Prices are one-day rental rates; longer rental periods quoted on request. Delivery charge $130 weekdays, $155 Saturdays until noon; minimum delivery order $125 and up depending on location/conditions. Delivery covers normal ground-floor delivery and pickup, not setup/takedown (quoted on request). Equipment must be stacked/packed as delivered. Dishes, silver, glassware delivered clean and must be washed right after use. Peak periods may need 4+ weeks notice. Propane equipment cannot be used indoors; certificate of liability insurance required to rent propane equipment; propane tank ordered separately. Stage/dance floor needs flat level surface. Where web page and PDF differ (e.g. padded bar stool 16.50 vs 17.50 in PDF) web page value used. No linens section exists in the guide. Items marked * in source: see Versailles cushions for stools. Unit not stated for most items (assumed each). Specs generally embedded in name as vendor wrote it.
